applies_to: J. Chem. Educ. articles, laboratory experiments and teaching figures

signature_features: thin plain line arrows, not bold (crops 01, 02); crop 02 uses paired equilibrium arrows for a reversible step
reaction name above the arrow in plain Arial (crop 02); reagents above the arrow with the ligand names in bold (crop 01)
ligand names in bold, coloured L1 teal #005474 and L2 orange #D87C5C (crop 01)
bold compound numbers with the isotopologue suffix in italic, as 1-dx and 2-dx (crop 01)
endo/exo prefixes in italic in the plain name labels under the structures (crop 02)

notes.compound_label_face: Bold compound numbers appear in crop 01 only among the reaction-scheme crops. Crop 02 has names, not numbers. Crop 07 (an assignment panel, not a scheme) is also bold. Null under the two-crop rule for top-level conventions; a figure that numbers its compounds takes bold from the figure.
notes.compound_label_italic_suffix: The italic d suffix appears in crop 01 only among the reaction-scheme crops (1-dx, 2-dx). Crop 07 writes the same compound as bold 1-d with italic d. Null under the two-crop rule.
notes.aromatic_rings: Kekule rings in crop 01 only; crop 02 has no aromatic ring. Null under the two-crop rule.
notes.reagent_text_color: Ligand colours (L1 teal, L2 orange) appear in crop 01 only; Pd(OAc)2 is black in crop 01. Null under the two-crop rule.
notes.arrow_style: Plain means thin, not bold: crops 01 and 02 agree on this. Crop 02 is a reversible scheme drawn with equilibrium half-arrows rather than a single arrow.
notes.yield_placement: No crop shows a yield. The earlier 72% note was wrong: crop 07 shows per-position %D labels only, with no yield and no DTot values.
notes.conditions_split: Reagents above and HFIP and D2O below appear in crop 01 only; crop 02 writes the reaction name above. Null under the two-crop rule.
notes.substrate_layout: Inline plus appears in crop 02 only (cyclopentadiene + maleic anhydride); crop 01 has no plus sign. Null under the two-crop rule.
notes.show_plus_sign: Plus sign appears in crop 02 only. Null under the two-crop rule.
notes.abbreviate_groups: tBu (superscript t) and CF3 (in the HFIP structure) appear in crop 01 only. Null under the two-crop rule.

measured.bond_length_over_cap_height: Crops 01 (2.18 = 30.5/14), 03 (2.28 = 28/12.3) and 06 (2.14 = 60/28) agree on about 2.2; crop 02 gives 2.46 (32/13). Kept at 2.2 by majority; spread 2.1 to 2.5. Crop 04 is a perspective model with no measurements, and its pixel estimate of about 1.4 is indicative only and not used.
measured.bold_width_over_bond_length: Crop 02 0.22 (7/32) and crop 03 0.25 (7/28). Spread 0.22 to 0.25; kept at 0.24. Two crops only.
measured.arrow_length_over_bond_length: No majority. Crop 01 single arrow 9.25 (282/30.5); crop 02 equilibrium pair 5.4 (173/32); crop 03 resonance arrow 1.6 (46/28, a mechanism figure). 9.2 is kept as the value of the single plain reaction arrow that arrow_style describes; the other values are recorded here, and a reversible scheme needs its own measure.

evidence.citation: Deufel, van Gemmeren et al., J. Chem. Educ. 2024 (Deuteration of arenes via Pd-catalyzed C-H activation: a lesson in nondirected C-H activation)
evidence.observations: two stacked reactions with long thin arrows; L1 teal and L2 orange in bold and Pd(OAc)2 in black above the arrow; HFIP structure drawn in light grey and bold D2O below; bold labels 1, 2, 1-dx with italic d; Kekule rings

evidence.citation: Birchall, Clark, Biagini et al., J. Chem. Educ. 2021 (Himic anhydride: a retro Diels-Alder reaction for the organic laboratory and an accompanying NMR study)
evidence.observations: equilibrium half-arrows with the reaction name above (Retro Diels-Alder, Diels-Alder); bold wedge and hashed bridgehead H; names under the structures, Endo and Exo in italic; plus sign between cyclopentadiene and maleic anhydride

evidence.citation: Elliott et al., J. Chem. Educ. 2026 (Exploring the interface of hyperconjugation and polarizability)

evidence.citation: Elliott et al., J. Chem. Educ. 2026 (Exploring the interface of hyperconjugation and polarizability)
evidence.observations: perspective model of the tert-butyl cation: empty p orbital drawn as white outlined lobes on the cationic carbon, the C-H bond lobe shaded grey, wedge and hash bonds; thin leader lines to plain-text explanations

evidence.citation: Deufel, van Gemmeren et al., J. Chem. Educ. 2024 (Deuteration of arenes via Pd-catalyzed C-H activation)
evidence.observations: More O'Ferrall-Jencks square with axis titles; mechanism names in ellipses with white text, AMLA / CMD in dark slate #2D3D3D and BIES / eCMD in navy #023554; red diagonal double arrow; legend boxes on the right in grey #C2CCCD, teal #80DADB and pink #F8C2CF, each with a bold title line whose colour differs by box

evidence.citation: Elliott et al., J. Chem. Educ. 2026 (Rethinking the nature and extent of inductive effects in organic compounds)
evidence.observations: two small structures side by side with black italic captions underneath; partial charges in red; bond-dipole arrows in blue, double-headed with crossing ticks; take-home statements in blue #0000FC plain text as footnote lines below the panel; too small to measure

signature_features: thin single-line arrow for reactions, about 9 bond lengths long in crop 01; equilibrium half-arrows for reversible steps, about 5 bond lengths long in crop 02
reaction name above the arrow in plain Arial (crop 02); reagents above and solvent below the arrow, with the ligand names in bold (crop 01)
ligand names in bold, coloured L1 teal #005474 and L2 orange #D87C5C, with Pd(OAc)2 in black (crop 01)
auxiliary structure (HFIP) drawn below the arrow in light grey, with D2O in bold (crop 01)
reaction_scheme.notes: no yields on either crop's arrows; the solvent, ligand and HFIP features rest on crop 01 alone; the arrow length spread (5.4 to 9.2 bond lengths) is recorded under the top-level measured notes

signature_features: each resonance or hyperconjugation pair enclosed in square brackets joined by a double-headed arrow
curved arrows black, same weight as bonds, full arrowheads, starting on the bond being broken
charges as circled + and - signs; lone pairs not drawn
a coloured caption under each pair naming the effect, blue #4C5C98 Arial
mechanism.notes: rests on one crop; the circled charge also appears in crop 04. No transition states drawn

signature_features: orbitals drawn as outlined lobes on the skeletal model; the interacting bond lobe shaded grey (crop 04)
each sp3 carbon of the chain carries one bold wedge H and one hashed H, and the left terminal carbon also has a plain H; bonds of interest labelled a and b in orange-red (crop 05)
explanations as plain text joined to the model by thin leader lines (crop 04 only)
stereo_model.notes: model_style and the leader-line feature rest on crop 04 alone. Crop 05 is a planar zigzag with wedge and hash bonds, not a perspective model, and has no text or leader lines. No CC BY J. Chem. Educ. article found in Europe PMC with a chair, Newman, Fischer, Zimmerman-Traxler or Felkin-Anh drawing; only perspective wedge/hash models are evidenced

signature_features: chemical shifts written straight onto the skeleton next to each carbon in orange #E43800, no atom numbers (crop 06)
deuterium percentages per position in bold teal #006C88, structure on a light grey #ECECEC box (crop 07)
position letters X and A in teal with a teal dot on carbon A (crop 07)
assignment_panel.notes: shift_color from crop 06; crop 07 uses teal for %D values, so the colour varies by article. highlight_fill #ECECEC rests on crop 07 alone (the grey box behind the structure). Crop 07 shows no yield and no DTot values, and its lack of atom numbers agrees with numbering_style none

signature_features: diagram with colour-filled legend boxes: grey #C2CCCD, teal #80DADB, pink #F8C2CF, each with a bold title line whose colour differs by box (crop 08)
category names in white text on ellipses: AMLA / CMD in dark slate #2D3D3D, BIES / eCMD in navy #023554 (crop 08)
small structures with black italic captions underneath (crop 09)
partial charges written in red (δ−, δ+, δδ+) on the structures, and bond-dipole arrows in blue, double-headed with crossing ticks (crop 09)
take-home statements in blue #0000FC plain text as footnote lines below the panel (crop 09)
concept_panel.notes: neither crop has panel letters; layouts differ (square diagram vs side-by-side pair). The legend title lines are dark slate, navy and red in crop 08, one per box
